role: Independent public-fixture expectations and fixed manual-port API before implementation; not product/physical acceptance
source_adoption: PENDING_ROOT_ACTUAL_MAIN_MESSAGE; runtime edits forbidden until then
independent_inputs: Existing public SSOT request/getkey and fixed signed-event response; Node Buffer constructs expected static envelopes, no QR encoder under test or host signing. Existing conformance metadata is explicitly synthetic/no-authority.
initial_RED_interpretation: New manual-qr module/API absent. An import/collection failure establishes missing mechanism only, never execution or acceptance of38cases. Preserve exact outcome.

contract.factory: createManualQrRouteDispatcher({ account_id, route_type, openPort }) -> existing SignerRequestDispatcher
contract.port: present(envelope) -> void|Promise<void>; scan() -> Promise<string|null>; close() -> void|Promise<void>
contract.ownership: One exclusive port owner across actual open/present/single-scan/close settlement; existing client owns all pending/deadline/session validation.
contract.revalidation: Existing before_write required and reused before actual presentation; trusted queued presenters call before_present themselves. No physical proof or device recall.
contract.capacity: Existing effective dimensions, no numeric ceiling increase. Reserve logical request JSON/frame + maximum response JSON/frame before opening; enforce raw bytes/work before conversion and exact decoded response size before parsing. No VM/native heap qualification.
contract.cleanup: No early settlement on cancellation. Rejecting opener or failed close quarantines owner; no automatic retry/ready declaration. Primary failure preserved if close also rejects.

case_groups.expect: Real handleLocalServiceRequestAsync/public get-key or sign-event, exact independent outgoing QR and signed response verification; exact account/request/pubkey controls; settled hook revoked.
Other valid configured account has no dispatcher fallback and zero opens.
Isolated response request-ID, expected pubkey, template, canonical-ID and signature faults fail real client verification.
Changed account, generation, availability, limits or monotonic deadline after open prevents presentation and closes once.
Exact client monotonic99/100/101 boundary: only99 eligible.
Raw frame, decoded, response, reassembly or aggregate-work overflow reaches adapter with valid bounded predicted positive shape; refuses before QR decode.
Logical retained payload reservation max-1/max/max+1, no open if insufficient.
First stale response scan terminates; no retry consuming a second valid response or cached approval.
Original scanned decoded duplicate/escaped-alias bytes reject before dictionary normalization.
Operator null scan fails, validated peer rejection remains a peer failure rather than consent.
Compact unsupported discovery and unadmitted message work refuse before opening, no downgrade.

Uncooperative open/present/scan/close reaches existing client deadline; same-context pending and cross-context port reservation stay occupied until actual settlement, late work/hook cannot produce success, later clean reuse succeeds.
Failed close quarantines owner; preserve prior protocol error when present.
Opener rejection with unknown partial effects quarantines owner; no new opens.

excluded: No new pending/session engine, transport/browser refactor, protocol/UR/framing freeze, default route, readiness, key/seed/signing, physical/provider/camera qualification, graph/CI/vendor/registry change.
